confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is least certain because July is peak season in Kenting and rates vary widely by weekend and beachfront location. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from a search-result excerpt attributed to the RBA exchange rates page; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Taiwanese beach and resort towns on the east coast such as Hualien and Taitung, adjusted for Kenting's July summer-peak demand and its resort-town premium on food and lodging.
